verdict.rationale: Algolia's own docs index names a first-party capability, 'AI Search (NeuralSearch) - Hybrid keyword + vector semantic search', which directly matches the story's core. However, the only evidence is a one-line catalog entry, with nothing on how fusion works, whether it happens in a single query, or how developers call it. missing for 10: documentation that keyword and vector results are fused in a single query request, API or parameter details for invoking hybrid/NeuralSearch, explanation of the fusion or ranking mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration.
